# Crossfade

**Blend › Crossfade** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (6–90)

Scene A fades out while scene B fades in. The classic dissolve.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/crossfade@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Time passing
- Soft scene changes
- Montages

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import crossfade from './transitions/02-blend/crossfade/crossfade';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(crossfade, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.
